{{Top|leg}}
'''Letters of Resources''' were an alternative for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], printed upon nearly indestructible plastic. Although they were a widely accepted form of currency within the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], many [[Star system/Legends |star systems]] outside of the Republic considered them worthless and would not honor them.

==History==
While on a mission to the [[Crseih system/Legends|Crseih system]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were in possession of a Letter of Resources which they could not successfully negotiate.<ref name="The Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[The Crystal Star]]'' {{1st}}
